Author Graham Hancock and archaeologist Flint Dibble join Joe Rogan for episode 2136 of the Joe Rogan Experience, a true debate. Hancock claims a lost high culture fell in the Ice Age. Dibble is a field scholar who says the proof fails.

The two men clash over sites, dates, and what a dig can truly show. Rogan keeps the peace as each man takes his swings. The talk is long, tense, and rich with facts on both sides.
